camel_example: aliyun ddoscoo ConfigWebCCTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId default --Domain 'www.aliyun.com' --Template default
description_en: Configures the mode of the Frequency Control policy for a website
description_zh: 设置网站业务频率控制防护（CC防护）的防护模式
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo config-web-cc-template --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --template default --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigWebCCTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The mode of the Frequency Control policy. Valid values:

default: Normal
gf_under_attack: Emergency
gf_sos_verify: Strict
gf_sos_enhance: Super Strict
parameters.help_zh:
频率控制防护（CC防护）的防护模式。取值：
default：正常
gf_under_attack：攻击紧急
gf_sos_verify：严格
gf_sos_enhance：超级严格
parameters.name: template
